images.title: Width to height is 60 : 40
images.purpose: Shows the ratio of width to height of image A as 60 : 40, with its two terms in order.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One rectangle in the upper middle, with the ratio written large underneath it.
images.exact_structure: One rectangle with a dark outline, 60 units wide and 40 units high, empty inside. Its bottom edge is drawn thick in teal (#0072B2) with the label 60 mm under it; its left edge is drawn thick in amber (#E69F00) with the label 40 mm beside it. Below the rectangle, large: 60 : 40, with 60 in teal and 40 in amber. Directly under that, smaller: width : height. Two short reddish purple (#CC79A7) pointer arrows come up from the word terms, placed below, one to the 60 and one to the 40. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A ratio compares two quantities in order: for every 60 mm of width there are 40 mm of height.
images.description: Shows the ratio of width to height of image A as 60 : 40, with its two terms in order.

image_decisions.why: Colour-matching each side to its term shows what a ratio and its terms are.
